    *   Shape D is clearly a plus sign (tetracross). A tetracross has an area of 4 units (if square side is 1). Two squares have an area of 2 units. Shape D is definitely impossible to make with only 2 squares.

    Therefore, the shape that cannot be made is **D**.

**Answer:** D
